. Now a pro-life speaker, Johnson discussed her journey on the panel at the Belo Center for New Media.
Johnson described herself as feeling very depressed following the life-changing experience, using alcohol, food, and exercise to cope with it. She said that the experience prompted in her a feeling of disconnection from God’s forgiveness. She said she ultimately prayed to God for help, and stated she feels God led her out of that time period, forgiving her and supporting her in ways she cannot articulate.
